scope_boundary: Classes, sequence diagrams and error handling. Entity ownership, classification and retention belong to the data viewpoint; two candidates surfaced here and were escalated rather than absorbed (LLD-F01, LLD-F02).

changes.content: RegistrationService — submit(command) -> RegistrationId; resolveStatus(producerId) -> EligibilityDecision. TokenValidator — validate(rawToken) -> Principal | TokenRejected. RoleProvisioner — provision(principal, onboardingRecord) -> Role. FboRegisterClient — lookup(fboNumber) -> Verified | Invalid | NoAnswer. ProducerRepository — append-only over identity_schema; supersede(registration) and NO update(registration).

```text
producer-portal -> RegistrationService : POST /v1/producers/registrations
RegistrationService -> RegistrationService : validate fbo_number format
RegistrationService -> RegistrationService : assert fbo_attestation == true   [server-side]
RegistrationService -> ProducerRepository : append Producer + FoodSafetyRegistration
                                            status = pending-verification
RegistrationService --> producer-portal : 201 Created { registrationId }
RegistrationService -> FboRegisterClient : lookup(fbo_number)   [async, out of band]
```

```text
FboRegisterClient -> competent-authority register : lookup
alt Verified
    FboRegisterClient -> ProducerRepository : append status = valid, supersedes prior row
    FboRegisterClient -> EventPublisher     : identity.registration.verified
else Invalid
    FboRegisterClient -> ProducerRepository : append status = rejected, reason passed through
    FboRegisterClient -> EventPublisher     : identity.registration.verified (outcome=rejected)
else NoAnswer
    FboRegisterClient -> RetryScheduler     : schedule bounded retry
    note: no row appended, no event emitted, status stays pending-verification
end
```

Malformed fbo_number -> 400 with a field-level problem detail; no row appended (S-F1.1-a-AC2). Missing attestation -> 422, refused server-side regardless of what the client sent (S-F1.1-a-AC3, ES1). FBO register non-answer -> NoAnswer, bounded retry with exponential backoff, registration stays pending; it is never promoted to valid on a timeout, and no 'assume valid' branch exists in the code path at all (S-F1.1-b-AC3). FBO register Invalid -> rejected, and the register's reason string is stored and passed through verbatim, never paraphrased.

FoodSafetyRegistration rows are append-only. A status change is a new row superseding the prior one; ProducerRepository exposes no update path for this entity, so 'supersede, never overwrite' is enforced by the absence of a method rather than by a code-review convention. The deduplication key for the emitted event is (producer_id, fbo_number, verified_on) — the business act, not the message id, which a producer's retry would regenerate.

resolveStatus(producerId) returns the latest non-superseded FoodSafetyRegistration row for that producer, ordered by appended_at. This satisfies getRegistrationStatus's p95 <= 250 ms budget only with an index on (producer_id, appended_at desc).

guardrails.correction_during_authoring: ProducerRepository was drafted with an update(registration) method, contradicting DAT-3.2's append-only rule. Replaced with supersede(registration).
